name: mentor-arena
description: Mentor Arena — 1-to-1 digital skills mentorship in Pakistan. Web Development, SEO, UI/UX & Digital Marketing, Generative AI, and office productivity tracks. Live Zoom cohorts, project-based 150-hour curriculum, Karachi-based mentor.

components.name: mentor-arena-website
components.description: Production React + Vite SPA serving 1-to-1 mentorship courses, enrollment, student dashboard, admin batches, and social media dashboard.

components.name: auth-service
components.description: Email + Google OAuth authentication endpoints (login, register, send-verification, verify-email, google).

components.name: leads-api
components.description: Public lead capture endpoint. Accepts name, email, phone, track, source.

components.name: enrollment-api
components.description: Batch enrollment endpoint. Accepts name, email, phone, city, batchId, note. Returns enrollment record with pending_payment status.

components.name: batches-api
components.description: Public list of available mentorship batches with schedules, Zoom links, and seat availability.

components.name: social-media-api
components.description: Social media posts CRUD + posting schedule for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube. Bi-weekly default schedule.

components.name: payment-gateways
components.description: Payment section with JazzCash (Till 984148029) and Zindigi/JS Bank (03322137898) QR codes. Raast instant transfer supported. Screenshot verification via WhatsApp/email.

courses.name: Generative AI & Autonomous Agents
courses.format: 1-to-1 live online, prompt engineering, RAG, LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, autonomous agent swarms

tools.name: robots-txt-generator
tools.description: Free robots.txt generator for webmasters. Configure crawl directives, sitemap URLs, and crawl-delay.

tools.name: seo-audit-framework
tools.description: Technical SEO audit methodology and blog articles covering on-page, technical, and local SEO.

technical.storage: MongoDB Atlas (preferred) with JSON file fallback
